decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 15 August 2005 the single storey detached building, for use as a gym room, store room, washing machine room and dryer and utility room, measuring 10.2 metres long, 4.5 metres wide and 3.53 metres high to top of flat roof ( 3.76 metres high to top of sky light) was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls outside the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the height of the flat roof exceeds 3 metres and the out building would be within 5 metres of the existing shed.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey detached building for use as a gym room, store room, washing machine room and dryer/utility room to rear of garden of house.
